If you no longer want the item, you still have a couple of options:
Refuse the delivery when the courier arrives (if the courier allows it), and the package will be returned.
Accept the delivery and start a return after it arrives, following the return instructions provided with your order.
Changes are only possible while the order is still being processed before dispatch.
